interpretations.plain_english_summary: This was Senate passage of a Congressional Review Act joint resolution disapproving a National Highway Traffic Safety Administration rule on hydrogen-vehicle fuel-system and compressed-hydrogen storage safety standards.
interpretations.yea_meaning: A Yea vote supported passing the joint resolution to nullify the NHTSA hydrogen-vehicle safety standards rule.
interpretations.nay_meaning: A Nay vote opposed passing the joint resolution, leaving the NHTSA hydrogen-vehicle safety standards rule in place through this vote.
interpretations.policy_effect: If enacted, the joint resolution would nullify the NHTSA final rule establishing Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards for hydrogen fuel systems and compressed hydrogen storage systems in hydrogen-powered vehicles.
interpretations.interpretation_reason: Official roll-call wording identifies passage of S.J.Res.55, and the Congress.gov title and summary describe the specific NHTSA rule the joint resolution would nullify.

interpretations.uncertainty_note: The official record identifies a motion to recess for ten minutes during consideration of S.J.Res.55. It does not show a direct policy choice on hydrogen-vehicle safety standards.
interpretations.interpretation_reason: Manual review left this as ambiguous because the vote was a floor-timing motion, not passage or rejection of the underlying joint resolution.
